_: Where each domain is described, and when it is not, why.
Read by `make doc-contract`. A code domain listed neither under "documente" nor under
"sans_page" fails the check, and so does a line that names nothing. Same idea as
scripts/api-pending.json: debt is declared, not endured.
"sans_page" is not a dumping ground. Each value says who decides what, not "not documented
yet". A reason nobody can reread in three weeks is a dead line.
Paths under "documente" are relative to docs/wiki/.

sans_page.server/connections: Settings → Integrations (GitHub/GitLab/Linear, OAuth or pasted token) has no guide yet; produit/etat.md lists what works and the known holes (no renewal, no revocation). The guide is owed by whoever closes renewal, since it changes what the page must tell the operator.
sans_page.web/connections: See server/connections: the screen half of the same subject, one guide for both.
sans_page.server/auth: No operator gesture: `/api/auth/identity` only reports, masked, which Claude credential the control plane reads from its environment (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` or `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`). Signing in to the interface is the operator domain, documented with the install guide. Becomes documentable when Claude credentials are set from the app.
sans_page.server/events: The global SSE stream has no screen and no setting: it replaces the interface's polling, and an operator only meets it as a screen that updates itself. What deserves documenting is its visible consequence (the screen can lag up to a minute when the stream is cut), and its place is the navigation page web/system is waiting for. The decision is in produit/decisions.md ("The screen listens instead of asking").
sans_page.web/events: See server/events: the other half. One EventSource for the whole app, a table turning an event into cache invalidation. Nothing for the operator to do, so nothing for a guide until the navigation page exists.
sans_page.server/environments: Network isolation is told in produit/decisions.md ("The network is not isolated by default"), not in a guide. Environments exist in the database but can no longer be created from the app, and removing the concept was decided on 08/09 and not done (produit/etat.md). No guide for a concept on its way out; whoever does or cancels that removal decides.
sans_page.web/system: The screen only gathers pages that already have their own (concepts/runner first). What is missing is not another link but a page describing the navigation: the bar and the two rails changed during the nav work and no page tells it. To be written with that page, not before.
sans_page.web/channels: The Channel view is described in produit/etat.md under "What just arrived". It deserves a guide when it stops being a second reading of the board and becomes the default one, the open question of docs/directions/direction-canaux.html, which is not settled.
